newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share prices tight ranged, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share prices tight ranged, volume down.

text.p: Shares at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius continued to move within tight price ranges on Friday and the absence of fresh factors left the market trendless, bourse officials said.
The market index, semdex, eased 0.04 points to 320.52 while transaction volume totalled 8.09 million rupees on 211,937 shares from 9.62 million rupees on 367,956 shares on Wednesday.
"Shares did not remain flat today as they have tended to be during the past few sessions," a bourse official said.
"(But) it has rather been a session lacking a general trend where some shares went up and some others down with the net overall result of the semdex hardly changing," he added.
He said the lack of general trend of the semdex reflected an absence of fresh news, especially on a long awaited government cabinet reshuffle from which a new finance minister is expected to emerge.

Former Mauritian finance minister Rundheersing Bheenick resigned in early August and his post has since been taken over by Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam. Economic analysts have forecast that deputy prime minister Paul Berenger, architect of the Mauritian economic success, will be given the job.
Ramgoolam told reporters on Thursday he had not yet made the cabinet reshuffle and again declined to indicative a date on when this would be carried out.
Transactions on Fincorp Investment accounted for most of trading while thin volume in the rest of the market reflected absence of general interest, brokers said.
Fincorp fell by 3.0 rupees to 69 on 94,600 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 72.50 rupees on 3,003 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.50 rupees on 57,468 shares.
Mauritius Chemical Fertilisers Industries gained 50 cents to 10.50 rupees on 5,829 shares.
Investment stocks Policy lost 10 cents to 3.40 rupees on 22,960 shares and Liberty Investment Trust was 30 cents lower to 10.70 rupees on 350 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert eased by 10 cents to 35 rupees on 2,750 shares but Mon Desert Alma (ordinary) jumped 3.0 rupees to 82 on 150 shares.
Rogers was stable at 89 rupees on 950 shares and Ireland Blyth lost 30 cents to 12.70 rupees on 3,050 shares. Happy World Foods added 10 cents to 14.10 rupees on 800 shares.
Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged at 34 rupees on 1,882 shares and New Mauritius Hotels eased 10 cents to 27.90 rupees on 1,100 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 50 rupees on 1,160 shares.
